card: Deliver a Capacitor bundle without waiting for a store release.
title: Native Update for app releases
intro: Native Update helps a Capacitor app carry a supported bundle update to the people using it. Store updates have their own path beside that flow.

sections.heading: What does Native Update ship?
sections.body: It handles Capacitor app updates without waiting for a store release for every bundle.

sections.heading: How can a bundle reach users?
sections.body: A supported bundle can be delivered over the air.

sections.heading: What happens with store updates?
sections.body: The product also covers in-app prompts for a store update and review.

sections.heading: Where does Native Update fit beside LifeWell?
sections.body: LifeWell has a web and Android release path. Native Update is a tool for people shipping Capacitor app bundles and store prompts.
